card.$comment: A box of a header, a body and a footer (1.9, 0108). It paints the surface the page stands on and an edge, not a shadow: a card is a part of the page, not something lifted over it, and a grid of twelve shadows is a grid of twelve blurs. Its three states swap colours and nothing else — the muted card wears the skin's disabled pair instead of `opacity`, which would take the text under its contrast and the controls with it.
card.$comment-border-hover: The one sign a pointer gets that the whole box answers it, when the card is one link: the edge darkens, as a field's does. The cursor says the rest.

border-hover.$description: Edge colour of a card that is one link, under the pointer.

padding-x.$description: Inline padding inside the card's edge.

padding-y.$description: Block padding inside the card's edge.

gap.$description: Gap between the card's header, body and footer.

header-gap.$description: Gap between the icon, the heading and the actions in the header.

title-font-size.$description: Font size of the card's title.

title-font-weight.$description: Font weight of the card's title.

subtitle-fg.$description: Text colour of the card's subtitle.

subtitle-font-size.$description: Font size of the card's subtitle.

footer-fg.$description: Text colour of the card's footer.

footer-font-size.$description: Font size of the card's footer.

card.$comment-muted: The disabled surface, the one every control wears when it is out of reach, with the muted text over it — not the disabled text: that pair measured 4.34:1 in the light skin and 3.07:1 in the dark on 2026-11-02, and the text of a muted card is still information, the last reading the device gave, so it is held to AA (`contrast.policy.json`).

fg-muted.$description: Text colour of a muted card.

message-fg-danger.$description: Text colour of the card's error message.

message-bg-danger.$description: Background of the card's error message.

icon-color-danger.$description: Colour of the icon beside the card's error message.
